Character.Name: Keyhole
Character.Description: Keyhole is the Field lead of the Latchkey Syndicate, working sealed apartments and corporate vaults. sets the crew plan and gives every member a clear way out. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: matte charcoal kits with brass hardware and gold lenses.
Character.Title: Field lead

Chatter.Description: Custom event chatter for Keyhole. dry heist banter and clear entry instructions; they are thieves, not mystics.
Spawned: Keyhole, Field lead, reporting from sealed apartments and corporate vaults.
WakeUp: Keyhole, eyes up. Latchkey Syndicate still has work to finish.
Attacking: Keyhole taking the field lead lane. leave the lock better than you found it.
Chasing: Keyhole on the pursuit. Keep my signal as I push them toward the sealed apartments and corporate vaults.
Waiting: Keyhole holding at the Latchkey staging point. Check your route before you move.
FriendDied: Keyhole here. We lost one of ours; I'll cover the crew while you mark the spot.
EnemyDown: Keyhole confirms one hostile down. Watch the next angle.
Wounded: Keyhole is hit! Still moving; get me behind cover!
Died: Keyhole signing off. Tell the Latchkey Syndicate crew I kept my word.
Chatter.Name: Keyhole - Latchkey Syndicate combat chatter
